summary: Added optional readingMinutes to native Astro posts and the paired Sveltia browser-editor form. The field accepts whole numeric minutes from 1 through 60 and renders as N min read on article detail only when supplied. Existing content and visual tokens were preserved; temporary acceptance posts were removed before the final build.

checks.result: Passed before implementation; existing Art Direction Record is structurally valid.
Unavailable: MCP is unavailable for this trial.

Passed lint, CSS contracts, art-direction gate, token audit, all 42 tests, and Astro typecheck (0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 hints). Tests accepted undefined, 1, 12 and 60; rejected 0, -1, 61, 1.5, numeric strings, empty strings, null, true, NaN and Infinity. Sveltia contract test verified optional integer storage, minimum 1, maximum 60, step 1 and no default.

checks.command: npm.cmd run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4357 (outside runner), then CUA browser inspection
checks.result: Preview started locally and was stopped after inspection. Browser showed 1 min read on the minimum detail route, 60 min read on the maximum detail route, no reading-time label on the existing welcome detail, and no label on either /posts/ or /. Inspected desktop screenshot and 320x800 narrow screenshot; label remained readable with no visible horizontal overflow. Initial navigation preceded server readiness and failed; a later navigation succeeded. Visibility options are unsupported in a subagent, so the successful tab used default visibility. Temporary viewport was reset and tab closed. No credentialed editor login/save was attempted.

checks.command: runner run build (after removing temporary acceptance posts)
checks.result: Passed final static build and postbuild release check; generated the original 4 routes only.
Passed: static release contains no styleguide route, fixture specimens or server entrypoint.
